method: Hourly event counts from accepted canonical minute bars; not a historical raw full-scan

binance_spot_trades.query: SELECT toStartOfHour(datetime) AS hour, sum(no_of_trades) AS event_rows, count() AS represented_minutes FROM origo.binance_spot_trades_time_revisions WHERE source_date >= toDate('2026-08-22') AND source_date < toDate('2026-09-21') AND (partition_key, revision, build_id) IN (SELECT partition_key, revision, build_id FROM origo.source_active_partitions WHERE source_key='binance_spot_trades' AND NOT provisional AND partition_start >= toDateTime('2026-08-22 00:00:00','UTC') AND partition_end <= toDateTime('2026-09-21 00:00:00','UTC')) GROUP BY hour ORDER BY hour
